verdict.rationale: Sierra markets a first-party Agent SDK for writing customer journeys as code within normal development workflows, with tracing, regression testing, and CI/CD publishing. The evidence is marketing-level only, largely a customer testimonial, and gives no detail on what the SDK actually is. Missing for 10: supported languages and package distribution, SDK reference docs or API surface, install/getting-started material, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
